capabilities: Check in habits from the right sidebar in single, goal, or timer modes
Track streaks and yearly, three-month, or monthly heatmaps
Embed live heatmap views in notes via code blocks
Color heatmaps by custom intensity levels
Retroactively check in for past dates
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README. Records are stored as per-day JSON files under the plugin folder to limit sync conflicts; the v0.1.7 upgrade backs up old data to backups/pre-activity-v2/ and halts loading if migration fails. Installable via Community plugins, BRAT, or manual download; requires Obsidian 1.2.0+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily habits, track streaks, or visualize check-in history inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Calendar plugin integration, and embeddable heatmaps in notes

summary: Habit tracker that lets you check in habits from the right sidebar and shows streaks plus GitHub-style yearly heatmaps you can embed in notes.
